english.title: Keep specimen at an address not specified on the permit
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person to whom an import permit was issued in accordance with Council Regulation (EC ) No 338/97 in respect of a live specimen of a species listed in Annex A to that Regulation, namely **(..SPECIFY..) which specifies an address at which the specimen must be kept, without reasonable excuse, kept that specimen at premises other than the specified address or location without prior written authority of the Secretary of State and in contravention of Article 9 of Council Regulation (EC ) No 338/97.
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 7(1) and (2) of the Control of Trade in Endangered Species (Enforcement) Regulations 1997.

english.notes:
This CJS Code and Offence wording document is now OBSOLETE - amalgamated into CJS Code ES97010 and H14944 with effect from 31/12/12.

(i) See Article 9 of Council Regulation (EC ) No 338/97 for conditions required to be satisfied for legal movement of specimens.
(ii) See Article 4(6) for restrictions on holding or movement of live specimens within the European Community.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
